![](../images/pitcher-1.jpg){group="pitcher" fig-alt="front view - pitcher"}

I like the colors on this pitcher a lot. And the carving on the bottom is great. 

I started making this a mug, and then realized it'd be a mug basically too large to carry (what can I say, I like a large mug). Then I put a spout on it for fun. It pours okay, works really pretty great for flowers. It's a funky, cool thing.
